summary: Defines a Uniform Resource Name namespace for UUIDs (also called GUIDs), 128-bit identifiers that can be generated without central coordination and are meant to be unique across space and time. The format comes from the Apollo and DCE systems and was later used on Microsoft Windows. It was replaced by RFC 9562.

eli5.summary: Imagine giving every grain of sand its own name tag, made up so cleverly that no two tags ever match, even if nobody compares notes. A UUID is that kind of tag for computer things.
